摘要Abstract

zh.html: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地检索外部整理的技能，即在决策时取用的程序性指令，以改善长程交互任务的表现。现有技能库通常被视为与模型无关：对能力和行为差异显著的底座模型复用同样的技能表述。然而，我们针对不同模型规模开展的受控实验表明，技能的效果高度依赖模型：有益于一个底座模型的技能可能损害另一个。基于这一观察，我们提出 MASA（模型感知技能对齐），在不修改智能体权重的情况下，针对每个目标底座模型适配技能。MASA 分两阶段运行：（1）分层技能演化流程，在环境反馈和模型能力画像的引导下，利用爬山搜索和 UCB 驱动的树搜索，迭代改写通用技能与任务专用技能；（2）利用演化轨迹训练轻量级、以模型为条件的技能改写器，在一次前向传播中复现这种适配。三个交互环境、四个底座模型上的实验表明，MASA 始终取得最佳总体表现，相比最强基线最高提升 25.8 个百分点。学到的改写器无需额外搜索，也能泛化至未见过的任务和环境，并以远低于大型教师模型的推理成本持续超越它。代码已公开。

en.html: LLM agents increasingly retrieve externally curated skills—procedural instructions retrieved at decision time—to improve performance on long-horizon interactive tasks. Existing skill libraries are typically treated as model-agnostic, reusing the same skill formulations across backbones with substantially different capacities and behaviors. However, our controlled experiments across multiple model scales show that skill effectiveness is strongly model-dependent: a skill that benefits one backbone can harm another. Motivated by this observation, we propose MASA (Model-Aware Skill Alignment), a framework that adapts skills to each target backbone without modifying agent weights. MASA operates in two stages: (1) a hierarchical skill evolution pipeline that iteratively rewrites general and task-specific skills using hill climbing and UCB-driven tree search, guided by environment feedback and model capability profiles; and (2) a lightweight model-conditioned skill rewriter trained on evolution trajectories to reproduce the adaptation in a single forward pass. Experiments across three interactive environments and four backbones show that MASA consistently achieves the best overall performance, with gains of up to 25.825.8 points over the strongest baseline. The learned rewriter further generalizes to unseen tasks and environments without additional search, consistently outperforming a much larger teacher LLM at a fraction of the inference cost. Our code is publicly available.11 1 https://github.com/jianxiangyu/MASA_

zh.html: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地解决网页导航、具身控制和工具使用等长程交互任务。引导这些智能体而不修改模型权重的一种常见方法，是在每一步从外部库中检索简短的程序性知识，我们称其为“技能”。现有技能库系统无论是人工编写，还是从智能体轨迹中蒸馏，通常都会构建一个共享库，并将其复用于不同的大语言模型底座。实际部署受延迟预算、推理成本和硬件可用性约束，智能体系统必须使用规模差异很大的底座模型，而不能只依赖最强模型。这种部署异质性给技能库设计提出了关键问题：同一种技能表述能否同样适用于能力差异显著的模型？<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Ouyang et al. (2026)；Lu et al. (2026)；Schick et al. (2023); Jiang et al. (2026); Wang et al. (2024a); Hsiao et al. (2025)；Wang et al. (2023); Wang et al. (2024b); Wang et al. (2024c); Chen et al. (2024); Zhao et al. (2024); Ma et al. (2026)；Zhu et al. (2023)；Zhao et al. (2024); Chen et al. (2024); Xia et al. (2026); Wang et al. (2025a)；Yao et al. (2025); Zheng et al. (2025)］</small>

en.html: LLM agents increasingly solve long-horizon interactive tasks, including web navigation Ouyang et al. (2026), embodied control Lu et al. (2026), and tool use Schick et al. (2023); Jiang et al. (2026); Wang et al. (2024a); Hsiao et al. (2025). A common approach to steer these agents without modifying model weights is to retrieve short pieces of procedural knowledge—which we call skills—from an external library at each step Wang et al. (2023); Wang et al. (2024b); Wang et al. (2024c); Chen et al. (2024); Zhao et al. (2024); Ma et al. (2026). Existing skill-library systems, whether hand-crafted Zhu et al. (2023) or distilled from agent trajectories Zhao et al. (2024); Chen et al. (2024); Xia et al. (2026); Wang et al. (2025a), typically construct a single shared library and reuse it across different LLM backbones. In practice, deployment constraints such as latency budgets, inference cost, and hardware availability mean that real-world agent systems must operate with backbones of vastly different scales rather than simply relying on the strongest available model Yao et al. (2025); Zheng et al. (2025). This deployment heterogeneity raises a critical question for skill-library design: can a single skill formulation serve models with substantially different capacities equally well?

zh.html: 为了检验这一点，我们在 ALFWorld 上开展实验（完整设置和分析见第 2 节）：保持技能库的原则不变，只改变表述粒度，并评估四个 Qwen3 底座模型（4B–32B）。如图 1 所示，最佳粒度因模型而异；事实上，提升一个底座模型表现的技能可能主动损害另一个。Gemma3 系列上的平行实验（附录 C.3）证实，不同模型家族也存在同样的模式，而且规模相同但家族不同的模型也偏好不同的技能表述。这表明，技能库的效果不仅取决于它编码了什么知识，还取决于这些知识相对于目标模型能力如何表达：表述不匹配时，检索到的技能会造成干扰，而不是提供帮助。设计良好的技能库应放大目标底座模型的优势，释放通用、模型无关技能无法激发的能力。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Shridhar et al. (2020)；Yang et al. (2025)］</small>

en.html: To examine this, we experiment on ALFWorl Shridhar et al. (2020) (full setup and analysis in §2): keeping the principles of a skill library fixed, we vary only its granularity and evaluate four Qwen3 backbones (4B–32B) Yang et al. (2025). As Figure 1 shows, the optimal granularity varies across models; indeed, a skill that boosts one backbone can actively degrade another. A parallel experiment on the Gemma3 family (Appendix C.3) confirms that the same pattern holds across families, and that models of the same size but from different families also prefer different skill formulations. This observation suggests that the effectiveness of a skill library depends not only on what knowledge it encodes, but also on how that knowledge is expressed relative to the target model’s capacity: when the expression is misaligned, retrieved skills distract rather than help. A well-designed skill library should amplify the strengths of its target backbone, unlocking capabilities that generic, model-agnostic skills cannot.

zh.html: 为此，我们提出 MASA，即模型感知技能对齐框架，在不修改智能体权重的情况下，让技能库的表述与每个目标底座模型对齐。MASA 将技能对齐视为由环境反馈驱动的分层搜索问题。首先，它执行分层的模型条件技能演化：能力更强的教师大语言模型在目标模型能力画像的引导下迭代改写技能，对通用技能采用爬山搜索，对任务专用技能采用 UCB 驱动的树搜索。为了在部署时摆脱成本高昂的教师模型，利用搜索发现的改写结果训练轻量级模型条件技能改写器；它只需一次前向传播即可适配技能，表现超越教师模型，而成本低几个数量级。

en.html: We pursue this goal with MASA, Model-Aware Skill Alignment, a framework that aligns the formulation of a skill library with each target backbone without modifying agent weights. MASA treats skill alignment as a hierarchical search problem driven by environment feedback. It first runs a hierarchical model-conditioned skill evolution: a stronger teacher LLM iteratively rewrites skills guided by a capability profile of the target model, applying hill-climbing over general skills and UCB-driven tree search over task-specific skills. To eliminate the costly teacher at deployment, the discovered rewrites train a lightweight model-conditioned skill rewriter that adapts skills in a single forward pass, outperforming the teacher while being orders of magnitude cheaper.

zh.html: 我们的主要贡献如下：

en.html: Our main contributions are as follows:

zh.html: 我们从实证上表明，不同模型需要不同的技能表述：同一技能库可能有益于一个底座模型，却主动损害另一个。这一发现挑战了“一套技能适用于所有模型”的假设，并为模型感知技能对齐提供了动机。

en.html:
We empirically demonstrate that different models require different skill formulations: the same skill library that benefits one backbone can actively degrade another.
This finding challenges the one-size-fits-all assumption and motivates model-aware skill alignment.

zh.html: 我们提出 MASA，使技能表述与各目标底座模型对齐。它结合迭代搜索以演化最优技能，以及轻量级改写器，将不匹配的技能转换为适合模型的形式。

en.html:
We propose MASA,
a framework that aligns skill formulations with each target backbone.
It combines iterative search to evolve optimal skills with a lightweight rewriter that transforms unaligned skills into model-appropriate ones.

zh.html: 我们在三个不同环境和四个 Qwen3 底座模型上评估 MASA，取得最高成功率，提升最多达 25.8 个百分点。MASA 改写器还可在一次前向传播中泛化到未见任务和环境，以极低成本超越规模大得多的教师大语言模型。

We evaluate MASA across three diverse environments and four Qwen3 backbones, achieving the highest success rate with gains up to <math id="S1.I1.i3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+25.8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>25.8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+25.8</annotation></semantics></math> points.
MASA-rewriter further generalizes to unseen tasks and environments in a single forward pass, outperforming a much larger teacher LLM at negligible cost.

zh.html: 2 预备研究：一个技能库无法适用于所有模型

en.html: 2 Preliminary Study: One Skill Library Does Not Fit All

zh.html: 在介绍 MASA 之前，我们先考察同一个技能库是否同样适用于各模型规模。为了区分技能形式与技能内容的影响，我们固定底层原则，只改变其文字表述的粒度。

en.html: Before introducing MASA, we ask whether a single skill library serves all model scales equally. To isolate the effect of skill form from skill content, we keep the underlying principles fixed and vary only the granularity of their textual expression.

zh.html: 2.1 实验设置

en.html: 2.1 Setup

zh.html: 我们使用 ALFWorld，这是一个覆盖六种任务类型的文本式家务任务集，并在验证集上评估。我们比较四个 Qwen3 底座模型（4B／8B／14B／32B）：它们共享架构和训练方案，主要区别在于容量。我们设置一个“无技能”对照条件，以及三个编码相同的行为原则、但表述深度不同的技能粒度级别。沿用先前工作，我们以 Xia 等（2026）的技能库作为“中等”版本，通过受控改写构建“精简”和“详细”版本，在调整粒度时保持底层原则不变（并排示例见附录 C.1 的表 4）。三个级别均使用同一检索流程，因此观察到的差异可归因于粒度本身。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Shridhar et al. (2020)；Yang et al. (2025)；Xia et al. (2026)］</small>

en.html: We use ALFWorld Shridhar et al. (2020), a text-based household task suite spanning six task types, and evaluate on the validation split. We compare four Qwen3 backbones (4B/8B/14B/32B) Yang et al. (2025) that differ primarily in capacity while sharing the same architecture and training regimen. We design one No Skill control and three skill-granularity levels that encode identical behavioral principles but differ in representational depth. Following prior work, we adopt the skill library of Xia et al. (2026) as the Moderate variant and construct the Concise and Detailed variants through controlled rewriting that preserves the underlying principles while adjusting granularity (see Table 4 in Appendix C.1 for side-by-side examples). All three levels use the same retrieval pipeline, ensuring that observed differences are attributable to granularity alone.

zh.html: 2.2 研究发现

en.html: 2.2 Findings

zh.html: 图 1 给出了 ALFWorld 的总体成功率。

en.html: Figure 1 reports overall ALFWorld success rates.

zh.html: 发现 1：最佳技能形式依赖模型，形式不匹配可能造成损害。

en.html: Finding 1: The optimal skill form is model-dependent, and mismatches can hurt.

zh.html: 没有任何粒度级别对所有模型都最优。Qwen3-4B 在中等粒度技能下表现最好，而 Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-32B 在详细技能下获得最高分。值得注意的是，Qwen3-8B 在无技能条件下表现最佳（32.1%），三个技能版本均使其表现下降。需要强调的是，这并不意味着技能天然与 Qwen3-8B 不兼容。轨迹检查显示，在没有外部指导时，Qwen3-8B 往往会采用简短而有效的行动链直接完成任务。不匹配的技能反而引入程序化推理模式，覆盖这些原本简洁的行动链，导致模型过度探索或进行不必要的斟酌。这说明技能效果不仅取决于内容，也取决于其表述是否与模型默认的问题解决策略兼容。

en.html: No single granularity level is uniformly optimal across models. Qwen3-4B performs best with Moderate skills while Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B achieve their highest scores with Detailed skills. Notably, Qwen3-8B performs best under the No Skill condition (32.1%32.1\%) and all three skill variants reduce performance. Importantly, this does not suggest that skills are inherently incompatible with Qwen3-8B. Trajectory inspection reveals that, without external guidance, Qwen3-8B often follows short and effective action chains that directly solve the task. Misaligned skills instead introduce procedural reasoning patterns that override these naturally concise action chains, causing the model to over-explore or deliberate unnecessarily. This suggests that the effectiveness of a skill depends not only on its content but also on whether its expression is compatible with the model’s default problem-solving strategy.

zh.html: 发现 2：粒度与表现的关系并非单调，简单启发式规则难以适用。

en.html: Finding 2: The granularity–performance relationship is non-monotonic and defies simple heuristics.

zh.html: 技能粒度应如何随模型能力变化并不明确：较小模型的上下文利用能力有限，可能受益于简洁指导；但推理能力较弱，也可能需要更明确的程序性监督。我们的结果表明，这两个方向都不能始终成立。在详细技能条件下，Qwen3-32B 虽然规模是 Qwen3-14B 的两倍，表现却低 4.6 个百分点，颠倒了通常的规模趋势。对 Qwen3-4B 而言，表现也不会沿任何方向单调改善：中等粒度优于精简和详细粒度，说明最优点位于中间，不能通过简单地“增加细节”或“压缩到最少”达到。这种复杂性要求基于搜索而非规则的技能适配。

en.html: It is unclear how skill granularity should scale with model capability: smaller models may benefit from concise guidance due to limited context utilization capacity, yet they may also require more explicit procedural supervision because of weaker reasoning abilities. Our results show that neither direction holds consistently. Qwen3-32B underperforms Qwen3-14B by 4.64.6 points under Detailed despite being twice the size, inverting the usual scaling trend. For Qwen3-4B, performance does not monotonically improve in either direction: Moderate outperforms both Concise and Detailed, indicating that the optimum lies at an intermediate level that cannot be reached by simply “adding more detail” or “stripping to minimum.” This complexity necessitates search-based rather than rule-based skill adaptation.

zh.html: 发现 3：不同任务类型的表现差异很大。

en.html: Finding 3: Performance varies sharply across task types.

zh.html: 逐任务结果（附录 C.2）显示，在同一模型与粒度组合下，不同任务类型的成功率可相差超过 60 个百分点，远大于单一任务上各粒度级别之间的差异。例如，Qwen3-14B 使用精简技能时，在 Pick 上得分 74.2，在 Cool 上仅为 13.7。有些任务类型无论模型大小都受益于详细技能，另一些对技能不敏感，甚至会受损。这种异质性表明，仅做全局优化还不够：技能对齐也必须在任务类型层面运行，以应对各类型的不同要求。

en.html: Per-task breakdown (Appendix C.2) reveals that within a given model–granularity pairing, success rates can vary by over 6060 points across task types—a spread far exceeding the differences between granularity levels for any single task. For example, Qwen3-14B with Concise skills scores 74.274.2 on Pick but only 13.713.7 on Cool. Some task types benefit from detailed skills regardless of model size, while others are insensitive or even harmed. This heterogeneity suggests that global optimization alone is insufficient—skill alignment must also operate at the task-type level to address the distinct demands of each task type.

zh.html: Gemma3 系列（4B／12B／27B）的平行实验揭示了相同的、依赖规模的趋势（附录 C.3），表明这一现象可跨模型家族泛化。

en.html: A parallel experiment on the Gemma3 family (4B/12B/27B) reveals the same scale-dependent trend (Appendix C.3), suggesting the phenomenon generalizes across model families.

zh.html: 启示。

en.html: Implications.

zh.html: 上述三个发现共同提出了具体的设计要求：

en.html: Together, the three findings impose concrete design requirements:

zh.html: 以模型为条件：最佳技能形式因底座模型而异，因此对齐必须明确考虑目标模型的能力（发现 1）。

en.html: Model-conditioned: the optimal skill form varies per backbone, so alignment must be explicitly conditioned on the target model’s capacity (Finding 1).

zh.html: 依靠搜索而非启发式规则：技能粒度与表现之间的关系非单调且因模型而异，不能采用简单的对齐规则（发现 2）。

en.html: Search-based rather than heuristic: the relationship between skill granularity and performance is non-monotonic and model-specific, ruling out simple alignment rules (Finding 2).

zh.html: 针对任务类型：在同一底座模型内，不同任务类型对同一技能的反应各异，因此除全局优化外，还需针对每种任务类型适配（发现 3）。

en.html: Task-type-specific: within the same backbone, different task types respond differently to the same skills, requiring per-task-type adaptation in addition to global optimization (Finding 3).

zh.html: 还需指出，我们的受控研究在保持内容不变的同时只改变了技能形式的一个维度，即文字粒度。实践中，决策策略、表述框架或格式的差异也可能造成不匹配，因此完整解决方案必须进行开放式的模型感知改写。MASA 正是为满足上述三项要求而设计。

en.html:
We further note that our controlled study varies only one axis of skill form (textual granularity) while holding content fixed.
In practice, misalignment can also arise from differences in decision strategy, framing, or format, suggesting that a complete solution must perform open-ended, model-aware rewriting.
MASA is designed to address all three requirements.

zh.html: 3 方法：MASA

en.html: 3 Method: MASA

zh.html: MASA 根据目标底座模型的能力画像调整技能演化，为每个模型生成专门适配的技能库，而非依赖通用的模型无关表述。MASA 由两个互补组件组成：搜索阶段的技能演化流程（第 3.2 节）在结构化模型卡提供的明确能力条件下演化技能；部署阶段的技能改写器（第 3.3 节）学习这种模型条件改写策略，并在一次前向传播中适配新技能。框架概览见图 2。

en.html: We present MASA, a framework that conditions skill evolution on the capability profile of a target backbone, yielding skill libraries specifically adapted to each model rather than relying on a universal, model-agnostic formulation. MASA comprises two complementary components: a search-time skill evolution pipeline (Section 3.2) that evolves skills under explicit capability conditioning provided by a structured model card, and a deployment-time skill rewriter (Section 3.3) that learns this model-conditioned rewriting policy and adapts new skills in a single forward pass. An overview of the framework is shown in Figure 2.

(2026), we structure 𝒮\mathcal{S} into two levels: general skills 𝒮G\mathcal{S}^{G} (cross-task strategy principles) and task-specific skills 𝒮T={𝒮Tc}c∈𝒞\mathcal{S}^{T}=\{\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}}\}_{c\in\mathcal{C}}, where each 𝒮Tc\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}} contains action guidelines tailored to task type cc and 𝒞\mathcal{C} is the set of all task types. At inference, a lightweight encoder (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B) separately retrieves top-kGk_{G} general skills and top-kTk_{T} task-specific skills for the current observation.

zh.html: 模型卡。

en.html: Model card.

zh.html: MASA 的关键条件信号是模型卡 M_F，即目标底座模型 F 的结构化画像。每张卡包含：（i）架构元数据（模型家族、参数量、层数／注意力配置、上下文窗口）；（ii）训练来源（训练数据规模、多语言支持）；（iii）能力画像（底座模型的优势与弱点）。构建流程详见附录 D。

en.html: The key conditioning signal in MASA is the model card ℳF\mathcal{M}_{F}, a structured profile of a target backbone FF. Each card contains: (i) architecture metadata (model family, parameter count, layer/attention configuration, context window), (ii) training provenance (training data scale, multilingual support), and (iii) capability profile (strengths and weaknesses of the backbone). The construction protocol is detailed in Appendix D.

zh.html: 3.2 分层的模型条件技能演化

en.html: 3.2 Hierarchical Model-Conditioned Skill Evolution

zh.html: 技能演化流程是由教师模型驱动、针对技能文本开展的搜索。更强的教师大语言模型 T：（i）分析 F 的失败轨迹，形成结构化的失败归因；（ii）在模型卡 M_F 的条件下改写技能，将修改导向与 F 已观察特征兼容的表述。

en.html: The skill evolution pipeline is a teacher-driven search over skill texts. A stronger teacher LLM TT (i) analyzes failure trajectories of FF to produce a structured failure attribution and (ii) rewrites skills conditioned on the model card ℳF\mathcal{M}_{F}, steering edits toward formulations compatible with FF’s observed characteristics.

zh.html: 两阶段优化。

en.html: Two-stage optimization.

zh.html: 该流程分阶段优化通用技能 S^G 和各任务专用技能 S^Tc，既出于计算效率考虑，也为了区分概念。从计算角度看，对 S^G 的一次修改需要在整个任务集上评估，而对 S^Tc 的修改只影响单个任务类型。从建模角度看，两层技能编码的是根本不同的知识。通用技能提供意在跨任务迁移的底座模型级行为指导（例如“始终确认动作是否被正确解析”）；任务专用技能则编码适配特定环境的领域流程（例如“先检查冰箱，再检查台面”）。因此，分开两个阶段能简化两层技能之间的贡献归因，并显著降低搜索成本。

en.html:
The pipeline optimizes <math id="S3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{S}^{G}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><mi>G</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{S}^{G}</annotation></semantics></math> and <math id="S3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\{\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}}\}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">{</mo><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>c</mi></msub></msup><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\{\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}}\}</annotation></semantics></math> in separate stages, motivated by both computational efficiency and conceptual separation.
From a computational perspective, a single edit to <math id="S3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{S}^{G}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><mi>G</mi></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{S}^{G}</annotation></semantics></math> requires evaluation over the full task suite, whereas edits to <math id="S3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>c</mi></msub></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}}</annotation></semantics></math> affect only a single task type.
From a modeling perspective, the two skill levels encode fundamentally different forms of knowledge.
General skills capture backbone-level behavioral guidance that is intended to transfer across tasks (e.g., “always verify your action parsed correctly”), while task-specific skills encode domain procedures tailored to particular environments (e.g., “check the fridge before the counter”).
Therefore,
separating the two stages simplifies credit assignment across the two skill levels while substantially reducing search cost.

zh.html: 阶段 1：通过迭代爬山搜索优化通用技能。

en.html: Stage 1: General skills via iterative hill climbing.

zh.html: 通用技能编码影响多个任务类型中智能体行为的高层行为先验。评估一个候选通用技能需要让智能体运行完整任务集，并汇总不同环境中的反馈，因此穷举搜索成本高得难以承受。我们于是使用迭代爬山搜索优化 S^G；这是在环境反馈下逐步改进当前技能集的一种简单有效策略。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Russell (2010)］</small>

en.html: General skills encode high-level behavioral priors that affect agent behavior across many task types. Evaluating a candidate general skill requires running the agent across the full task suite and aggregating feedback over diverse environments, making exhaustive search prohibitively expensive. We therefore optimize 𝒮G\mathcal{S}^{G} via iterative hill climbing Russell (2010), which provides a simple and effective strategy for progressively improving the current skill set under environment feedback.

zh.html: 每次迭代按如下步骤进行。执行：让配备当前最佳通用技能的目标模型 F 运行所有任务类型，计算各轮奖励。分析：教师收集这些运行中的失败轨迹，形成结构化失败归因，重点关注通用行为缺陷，而不是任务专用的流程缺口。改写：给定当前最佳技能集、失败归因、模型卡 M_F，以及先前所有迭代中奖励最高的 K 个技能集（使教师能从完整优化轨迹而非仅最近一次失败中学习），教师输出修订后的通用技能集。接受／拒绝：在完整任务集上评估新候选，仅当其奖励高于当前最佳值时才接受。搜索最多进行 I 次迭代，或在连续 p 次迭代均无改进时终止。

en.html: Each iteration proceeds as follows. Rollout: the target model FF equipped with the current best general skills is rolled out across all task types to compute the reward across episodes. Analysis: the teacher collects failed trajectories from these rollouts and produces a structured failure attribution focusing on general behavioral deficiencies rather than task-specific procedural gaps. Rewrite: given the current best skill set, the failure attribution, the model card ℳF\mathcal{M}_{F}, and the KK highest-reward skill sets from all previous iterations (which help the teacher learn from the full optimization trajectory rather than only the most recent failure), the teacher outputs a revised general skill set. Accept/Reject: the new candidate is evaluated on the full task suite and accepted only if it achieves a higher reward than the current best. Search terminates after at most II iterations or after pp consecutive iterations without improvement.

zh.html: 阶段 2：按任务类型进行树搜索，优化任务专用技能。

en.html: Stage 2: Task-specific skills via per-type tree search.

zh.html: 与通用技能不同，任务专用技能编码领域流程；对于同一种任务类型，多种结构不同的策略都可能有效。因此需要树形搜索探索不同分支，而非只沿单一路径精炼。我们对每种任务类型 c 独立运行树搜索：每个节点保存一个候选任务专用技能集 S^Tc，每条边代表一次教师改写。

en.html:
Unlike general skills, task-specific skills encode domain procedures where multiple structurally different strategies may be effective for the same task type.
This motivates a tree-structured search that can explore diverse branches rather than committing to a single refinement path.
We run an independent tree search per task type <math id="S3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="c" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>c</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c</annotation></semantics></math>, where each node holds a candidate task-specific skill set <math id="S3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msup><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒮</mi><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>c</mi></msub></msup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}}</annotation></semantics></math> and each edge corresponds to a teacher rewrite.

zh.html: 每次迭代包括四步。选择：从根节点开始，递归应用 UCB1 选择最有希望的叶节点，在利用高奖励节点和探索访问较少的节点之间取得平衡。扩展：目标模型 F 使用选定节点的技能集运行 c 类型任务；教师收集失败轨迹、形成失败归因并输出修订后的任务专用技能集，生成新的子节点。评估：在 c 类型任务上评估新子节点的技能集，取得平均奖励。反向传播：将奖励从新节点沿路径传回根节点，更新各节点的访问次数和值估计。不同任务类型的搜索树互相独立，可完全并行。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Kocsis and Szepesvári (2006)］</small>

en.html: Each iteration proceeds in four steps. Selection: starting from the root, UCB1 Kocsis and Szepesvári (2006) is applied recursively to select the most promising leaf node, balancing exploitation of high-reward nodes with exploration of less-visited ones. Expansion: the target model FF is rolled out on type-cc tasks using the selected node’s skill set, and the teacher collects failed trajectories, produces a failure attribution, and outputs a revised task-specific skill set—forming a new child node. Evaluation: the new child’s skill set is evaluated on type-cc tasks to obtain its average reward. Backpropagation: the reward is propagated from the new node back to the root, updating visit counts and value estimates along the path. Per-type trees are independent and fully parallelizable.

zh.html: 总体上，两阶段顺序执行：阶段 1 得到的最优通用技能 S^G*_F 在阶段 2 期间保持固定，最终输出适配特定模型的技能库 S*_F，其中包含最优通用技能和各任务类型的最优专用技能。详细步骤见算法 1 和 2；两阶段搜索的更多细节见附录 E。

en.html: Overall, the two stages run sequentially: 𝒮G⋆F\mathcal{S}^{G\star}_{F} obtained in Stage 1 is held fixed throughout Stage 2, and the final output is a model-specific skill library 𝒮F⋆=(𝒮FG⋆,{𝒮FTc⋆}c∈𝒞)\mathcal{S}^{\star}_{F}=(\mathcal{S}^{G\star}_{F},\{\mathcal{S}^{T_{c}\star}_{F}\}_{c\in\mathcal{C}}). The detailed procedures are given in Algorithms 1 and 2, and further details of the two-stage search are provided in Appendix E.

zh.html: 3.3 模型条件技能改写器

en.html: 3.3 Model-Conditioned Skill Rewriter

zh.html: 技能演化流程可以产生高效的技能库，但需要大量算力（数百到数千次完整环境运行）和环境提供的奖励信号。MASA 改写器学习演化流程隐含执行的改写策略，使技能能够以低成本适配新领域和任务，而无需进一步与环境交互。

en.html:
The skill evolution pipeline delivers strong skill libraries but requires substantial compute (hundreds to thousands of full-environment rollouts) and an environment-provided reward signal.
MASA-Rewriter addresses this by learning the rewriting policy that the evolution pipeline implicitly executes, enabling cheap adaptation to new domains and tasks without further environment interaction.

en.html: Complementary roles.

zh.html: 技能演化流程通过显式搜索提供各底座模型的表现上界，并生成训练技能改写器所需的信号。MASA 改写器将这项搜索的成本摊销到一次前向传播中，实现无需环境交互的快速适配。运行预算允许充分优化时，适合使用演化流程；计算资源受限的部署场景则更适合使用改写器。

en.html:
The skill evolution pipeline provides per-backbone upper bounds via explicit search and produces the skill rewriter’s training signal for the skill rewriter.
MASA-Rewriter amortizes this search into a single forward pass, enabling rapid adaptation without environment interaction.
The evolution pipeline is preferred when rollout budget permits thorough optimization, whereas the skill rewriter is better suited to compute-constrained deployment scenarios.

zh.html: 4 实验

en.html: 4 Experiments

zh.html: 我们评估模型条件技能演化是否能在不同环境和底座模型上超越模型无关的基线，以及 MASA 改写器能否在无需额外搜索的情况下，将学到的改写策略泛化到保留的任务类型和未见过的环境。

en.html: We evaluate whether model-conditioned skill evolution outperforms model-agnostic baselines across diverse environments and backbones, and whether MASA-Rewriter can generalize the learned rewriting policy to held-out task types and unseen environments without additional search.

zh.html: 4.1 实验设置

en.html: 4.1 Experimental Setup

zh.html: 环境。

en.html: Environments.

zh.html: 我们在三个动作空间和推理要求不同的环境上评估。（i）ALFWorld 是文本式具身环境，智能体通过文字命令在房间中导航并与物体交互，完成加热、清洁和拾取物体等家务任务。它包含六种难度不一的任务类型。（ii）WebShop 模拟网上购物：智能体浏览逼真的网页界面、搜索商品、比较属性并作出符合自然语言用户要求的购买决策。（iii）搜索增强问答要求智能体从网页搜索结果中检索并综合信息。我们纳入七个基准，覆盖单跳推理（NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA）和多跳推理（HotpotQA、2Wiki、MuSiQue、Bamboogle）。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Shridhar et al. (2020)；Yao et al. (2022a)；Kwiatkowski et al. (2019)；Joshi et al. (2017)；Mallen et al. (2023)；Yang et al. (2018)；Ho et al. (2020)；Trivedi et al. (2022)；Press et al. (2023)］</small>

en.html: We evaluate on three environments spanning distinct action spaces and reasoning demands. (i) ALFWorld Shridhar et al. (2020) is a text-based embodied environment where agents complete household tasks (e.g., heating, cleaning, picking up objects) by issuing text commands to navigate rooms and interact with objects. It contains six task types with varying difficulty. (ii) WebShop Yao et al. (2022a) simulates online shopping: agents navigate a realistic web interface, search for products, compare attributes, and make purchase decisions that satisfy natural-language user specifications. (iii) Search-augmented QA requires agents to retrieve and synthesize information from web search results. We include seven benchmarks covering both single-hop (NQ Kwiatkowski et al. (2019), TriviaQA Joshi et al. (2017), PopQA Mallen et al. (2023)) and multi-hop reasoning (HotpotQA Yang et al. (2018), 2Wiki Ho et al. (2020), MuSiQue Trivedi et al. (2022), Bamboogle Press et al. (2023)).

zh.html: 底座模型与基线。

en.html: Backbones and baselines.

zh.html: 目标智能体使用 Qwen3-{4B, 8B, 14B, 32B}；所有 Qwen3 底座模型均采用非思考模式。这一选择反映了延迟和 token 预算受限的常见部署场景，也确保观察到的表现差异可归因于技能设计，而不是推理模式配置。教师大语言模型为 DeepSeek-V4-Pro。我们与三个基线比较：（1）无技能：不添加技能的原始底座模型；（2）基础技能：来自 SkillRL 的初始技能库，未经模型专用适配便由所有底座模型共享；（3）DS-Adapter：在模型卡 M_F 条件下，由教师对基础技能库进行一次性改写，不进行迭代搜索。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Yang et al. (2025)；DeepSeek-AI (2026)；Xia et al. (2026)］</small>

en.html: Target agents are Qwen3-{4B, 8B, 14B, 32B} Yang et al. (2025); 22 2 All Qwen3 backbones are used in non-thinking mode. This choice reflects typical deployment scenarios where latency and token budgets are constrained, and ensures that observed performance differences are attributable to skill design rather than reasoning-mode configuration. the teacher LLM is DeepSeek-V4-Pro DeepSeek-AI (2026). We compare against three baselines: (1) No Skill (the raw backbone without any skill augmentation), (2) Base Skill (the initial skill library from SkillRL Xia et al. (2026), shared across all backbones without model-specific adaptation), and (3) DS-Adapter (a one-shot teacher rewrite that adapts the Base Skill library conditioned on the model card ℳF\mathcal{M}_{F}, without iterative search).

MASA achieves the highest average success rate for every backbone: <math id="S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="31.4" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>31.4</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">31.4</annotation></semantics></math> (4B), <math id="S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="57.9" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>57.9</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">57.9</annotation></semantics></math> (8B), <math id="S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="64.3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>64.3</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">64.3</annotation></semantics></math> (14B), and <math id="S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m4" class="ltx_Math" alttext="65.7" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mn>65.7</mn><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">65.7</annotation></semantics></math> (32B), with gains of <math id="S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m5" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+4.3" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>4.3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+4.3</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m6" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+25.8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>25.8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+25.8</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m7" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+20.0" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>20.0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+20.0</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math id="S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.m8" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+20.7" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>20.7</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+20.7</annotation></semantics></math> over the strongest baseline respectively.
We highlight several observations:

zh.html: （1）逐任务优势。除汇总结果外，MASA 在多数单独任务类型上取得最佳成功率。对 Qwen3-14B 和 32B，MASA 在全部六种任务类型中同时排名第一，说明演化技能提高总体表现时，并未牺牲任务覆盖面。

en.html: (1) Per-task dominance. Beyond the aggregate, MASA achieves the best per-task SR in most individual task types. For Qwen3-14B and 32B, MASA ranks first on all six task types simultaneously, indicating that the evolved skills improve overall performance without sacrificing coverage across tasks.

zh.html: （2）模型无关技能可能造成损害。基础技能和 DS-Adapter 在个别任务上出现严重的表现下降，表明通用技能或一次性适配技能可能产生模型特定的冲突。MASA 则通过迭代的模型条件搜索避免了这些退化。

en.html: (2) Model-agnostic skills can hurt. Base Skill and DS-Adapter exhibit severe performance drops on individual tasks, indicating that generic or one-shot adapted skills can introduce model-specific conflicts. In contrast, MASA avoids these regressions through iterative model-conditioned search.

zh.html: （3）规模效应。8B 及以上的底座模型具备足够能力利用模型专用技能，因此获得显著提升。4B 的收益相对有限，可能是因为其固有能力上限限制了技能指导能带来的帮助。

en.html: (3) Scaling behavior. For 8B and above, the backbones have sufficient capacity to leverage model-specific skills, yielding substantial improvements. The gain on 4B is comparatively modest, likely due to the backbone’s inherent capability ceiling limiting how much skill guidance can help.

zh.html: （4）推理效率。MASA 持续降低平均交互步数（例如 8B 从 39.1 降至 29.2，14B 从 36.7 降至 25.7）。通过针对各底座模型的特定行为模式定制技能，MASA 帮助智能体更准确地定位目标物体并执行正确的动作序列，减少重复探索和失败尝试。

en.html: (4) Inference efficiency. MASA consistently reduces average interaction steps (e.g., 8B: 39.1→29.239.1\to 29.2; 14B: 36.7→25.736.7\to 25.7). By tailoring skills to each backbone’s specific behavior patterns, MASA helps the agent locate target objects and execute correct action sequences more precisely, reducing redundant exploration and failed attempts.

en.html: WebShop.

zh.html: MASA 在每个底座模型上再次取得最高成功率和得分，显著超越所有基线。WebShop 也揭示了较大 Qwen3 模型面临的一项关键挑战：

en.html:
MASA again achieves the highest success rate and score for every backbone, substantially outperforming all baselines.
WebShop reveals a critical challenge for larger Qwen3 models:

zh.html: （1）未经适配时，大模型表现不如 4B。值得注意的是，WebShop 上的 8B／14B／32B 基线均不如 4B（例如，14B 无技能成功率为 2.8%，4B 无技能为 23.0%）。我们将原因追溯到过量的思维链生成：较大模型在每个动作前输出冗长的推理前言，使动作文本变长，把固定的步骤预算耗在思考而非环境交互上（详细统计见附录 G）。模型无关技能并未针对这种模型特定的行为模式设计，因此帮助有限，有时还会进一步损害表现。

en.html: (1) Larger models perform worse than 4B without adaptation. Notably, 8B/14B/32B baselines all underperform 4B on WebShop (e.g., 14B No Skill: 2.8%2.8\% vs. 4B No Skill: 23.0%23.0\%). We trace this to excessive chain-of-thought generation: larger models produce verbose reasoning preambles before each action, inflating action length and exhausting the step budget on deliberation rather than environment interaction (detailed statistics in Appendix G). Since model-agnostic skills are not designed to address this model-specific behavioral pattern, they provide limited benefit and in some cases further degrade performance.

zh.html: （2）MASA 应对了这一挑战。在各底座模型行为画像的条件下演化技能后，MASA 引导模型采用有效的行动模式，4B／8B／14B／32B 的成功率分别达到 26.4／28.6／29.2／34.6，远超全部基线。效率收益也很明显：成功完成任务的基线平均需要 12–13 步，而 MASA 只需 7–8 步就取得更高成功率，8B 更降至 4.7 步。

en.html: (2) MASA addresses this challenge. By evolving skills conditioned on each backbone’s behavioral profile, MASA guides models toward effective action patterns—achieving SR of 26.426.4 (4B), 28.628.6 (8B), 29.229.2 (14B), and 34.634.6 (32B), far surpassing all baselines. The efficiency gain is also notable: baselines that do succeed average 1212–1313 steps, whereas MASA achieves higher SR in only 77–88 steps, dropping to just 4.74.7 steps on 8B.

zh.html: 搜索增强问答。

en.html: Search-augmented QA.

zh.html: 表 2 显示，MASA 在每个底座模型上都取得最高平均成功率。技能演化只在 NQ 和 HotpotQA 上进行，但收益有力地泛化至分布外基准（⋆）：例如在 4B 上，MASA 将 Bamboogle 从最强基线的 12.9 提升至 61.3。在最大底座模型 32B 上，MASA 在七个数据集中的五个排名第一。这些结果表明，演化技能学到的是可迁移的检索和推理策略，而不是对演化阶段使用的数据集过拟合。

en.html: Table 2 shows that MASA achieves the highest average SR for every backbone. Skill evolution is conducted only on NQ and HotpotQA, yet the gains generalize strongly to out-of-domain benchmarks (⋆\star)—e.g., on 4B, MASA improves Bamboogle from 12.912.9 (best baseline) to 61.361.3. On the largest backbone (32B), MASA ranks first on 5 out of 7 datasets. These results demonstrate that the evolved skills capture transferable strategies for retrieval and reasoning, rather than overfitting to the datasets used during skill evolution.

zh.html: 4.3 技能改写器的泛化能力

en.html: 4.3 Skill Rewriter Generalization

attrs.alt: 图 3：MASA 改写器在保留的 ALFWorld 任务类型上的分布外泛化。粉色柱表示基线，蓝色柱表示 MASA 改写器的不同版本。

zh.html: 图 3：MASA 改写器在保留的 ALFWorld 任务类型上的分布外泛化。粉色柱表示基线，蓝色柱表示 MASA 改写器的不同版本。

en.html: Figure 3: OOD generalization of MASA-Rewriter on held-out ALFWorld task types. Pink bars denote baselines and blue bars denote MASA-Rewriter variants.

zh.html: 我们保留 ALFWorld 的三种任务类型（Clean、Heat、Cool）不参与训练，再要求 MASA 改写器为它们生成任务专用技能，以评估其能否适配训练中未见的任务类型。通用技能保持不变。

en.html: We evaluate whether MASA-Rewriter can adapt skills for task types not seen during its training, by holding out three ALFWorld task types (Clean, Heat, Cool) and asking MASA-Rewriter to produce task-specific skills for these types. The general skills remain unchanged.

zh.html: 我们与三个基线比较：基础技能、4B-Rewrite（未经监督微调的 Qwen3-4B 改写器，即架构与 MASA 改写器相同，但未学会改写能力）和 DS-Adapter（针对特定保留任务的教师单次改写）。两个 MASA 改写器版本的训练数据组成不同：

en.html: We compare against three baselines: Base Skill, 4B-Rewrite (Qwen3-4B used as a rewriter without SFT—i.e., the same architecture as MASA-Rewriter but without learned rewriting ability), and DS-Adapter (one-shot teacher rewrite targeting the specific held-out task). The two MASA-Rewriter variants differ in training data composition:

zh.html: 跨环境迁移。

en.html: Cross-environment transfer.

zh.html: MASA 改写器仅使用 Search 和 WebShop 的技能演化轨迹训练，然后直接用于 ALFWorld，没有任何目标环境数据。尽管环境差异很大（动作空间和观察格式均不同），跨环境 MASA 改写器在四个底座模型上都优于 DS-Adapter（图 3），提升分别为 4B 的 1.5、8B 的 3.0、14B 的 2.9 和 32B 的 3.0 个百分点。这说明学到的改写策略捕获了可跨环境迁移的模型专用适配模式：即使训练时未接触目标环境，改写器也能生成有用技能。

en.html: MASA-Rewriter is trained exclusively on skill evolution traces from Search and WebShop, then applied to ALFWorld without any in-environment data. Despite the substantial environment gap (different action spaces and observation formats), Cross-env MASA-Rewriter outperforms DS-Adapter on all four backbones (Figure 3), with gains of +1.5+1.5 (4B), +3.0+3.0 (8B), +2.9+2.9 (14B), and +3.0+3.0 (32B). This demonstrates that the learned rewriting policy captures model-specific adaptation patterns that transfer across environments—the rewriter can produce useful skills even without exposure to the target environment during training.

zh.html: 跨任务迁移。

en.html: Cross-task transfer.

zh.html: 在跨环境版本的基础上，此版本还使用 ALFWorld 另外三种任务类型（Pick、Look、Pick2）的演化轨迹，但排除保留的评估类型。跨任务 MASA 改写器相比 DS-Adapter 获得大幅提升：8B 为 8.8、14B 为 13.2、32B 为 7.4 个百分点。相对跨环境版本，8B 和 14B 的收益尤其显著（分别增加 5.8 和 10.3），说明即使来自其他任务类型的技能，也能为适配环境特有的交互模式和观察结构提供有价值的监督。

en.html: Building on Cross-env, this variant additionally uses evolution traces from three other ALFWorld task types (Pick, Look, Pick2), excluding the held-out evaluation types. Cross-task MASA-Rewriter achieves substantially larger gains: +8.8+8.8 (8B), +13.2+13.2 (14B), and +7.4+7.4 (32B) over DS-Adapter. The gains over Cross-env are especially large on 8B (+5.8+5.8) and 14B (+10.3+10.3), suggesting that even skills from unrelated task types provide valuable supervision for adapting to environment-specific interaction patterns and observation structures.

zh.html: 值得注意的是，仅有 4B 参数的 MASA 改写器持续超越由 DeepSeek-V4 驱动的 DS-Adapter，表明经过训练的小型改写器能以远低于大型教师模型的推理成本取得更好的表现。

en.html: Notably, MASA-Rewriter (4B parameters) consistently surpasses DS-Adapter powered by DeepSeek-V4, demonstrating that a small trained rewriter can outperform a much larger teacher at a fraction of the inference cost.

zh.html: 5 结论

en.html: 5 Conclusion

zh.html: 我们提出 MASA，动机是智能体技能设计中“一套技能适用于所有模型”的假设在不同模型规模下并不成立。MASA 通过分层技能演化和轻量级模型条件改写器应对这一问题，将搜索过程摊销到一次前向传播中。在三个环境和四个 Qwen3 底座模型上，MASA 在所有设置中均取得最佳成功率，最多提升 25.8 个百分点。改写器还以几乎可以忽略的部署成本泛化至未见任务和环境。

en.html:
We presented MASA, motivated by the observation that the one-size-fits-all assumption in agent skill design breaks down across model scales.
MASA addressed this through hierarchical skill evolution and a lightweight model-conditioned rewriter that amortizes search into a single forward pass.
Across three environments and four Qwen3 backbones,
MASA achieved the best success rate in all settings, with gains up to <math id="S5.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="+25.8" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>25.8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">+25.8</annotation></semantics></math> points.
The rewriter further generalized to unseen tasks and environments at negligible deployment cost.

zh.html: 我们希望这项工作促使人们把技能视为应针对目标底座模型适配的模型感知产物，而非在能力不同的模型间统一共享。经过恰当对齐，即使较小的模型也可能呈现过去通常与前沿规模系统相关的行为，从而支持更普惠、资源效率更高的部署。展望未来，我们将 MASA 改写器设想为轻量级、即插即用的中间件，自动为新的底座模型改写现有技能库，无需环境运行、重新训练或人工提示词工程。这使技能对齐成为基础设施，而非每次部署都要重复进行的工程工作。

en.html:
We hope this work motivates treating skills as model-aware artifacts that should be adapted to their target backbone rather than shared uniformly across models of different capacities.
With proper alignment, even compact models can exhibit behaviors traditionally associated with frontier-scale systems, enabling more accessible and resource-efficient deployment.
Looking forward, we envision MASA-Rewriter as a lightweight plug-and-play middleware that automatically rewrites existing skill libraries for new backbones, requiring no environment rollouts, retraining, or manual prompt engineering.
This positions skill alignment as infrastructure rather than a per-deployment engineering effort.

zh.html: 局限性

en.html: Limitations

zh.html: 目前的实证证据仅限于 Qwen3 系列（4B／8B／14B／32B）。将技能演化和改写器扩展到更多模型家族，包括开放权重模型（如 Llama、Mistral）和专有模型（如 GPT-o3、Claude），以及更多样的环境，将进一步增强技能改写器的普遍适用性，但需要明显更多算力。特别是，对闭源模型应用演化流程，需要通过付费 API 进行数百次环境运行，使每个底座模型的搜索成本显著高于本地托管模型；在取得少数底座模型的轨迹后，技能改写器可通过摊销这项成本部分缓解问题。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Grattafiori et al. (2024)；Liu et al. (2026)；OpenAI (2025)；Anthropic (2024)］</small>

en.html: Our empirical evidence is currently restricted to the Qwen3 family (4B/8B/14B/32B); extending the skill evolution and rewriter to cover more model families—both open-weight (e.g., Llama Grattafiori et al. (2024), Mistral Liu et al. (2026)) and proprietary (e.g., GPT-o3 OpenAI (2025), Claude Anthropic (2024))—and more diverse environments would further strengthen the generality of the skill rewriter, though it requires substantially more compute. In particular, applying the evolution pipeline to closed-source models demands hundreds of environment rollouts through paid APIs, making the per-backbone search cost significantly higher than for locally hosted models; the the skill rewriter rewriter offers a partial remedy by amortizing this cost once trajectories from a few backbones are available.

zh.html: 此外，技能改写器使用来自 ALFWorld、WebShop 和搜索问答的技能演化轨迹训练，演化流程本身依赖能提供自动成功／失败信号的环境（如任务完成标志）来判断改写后的技能是否有效。要纳入不提供这类内置奖励信号的领域（如开放式网页任务或真实世界应用），就必须设计外部评估器或引入人工标注，但这也能使框架服务于更广泛的智能体应用。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Sun et al. (2025)］</small>

en.html: Additionally, the skill rewriter is trained on skill-evolution trajectories collected from ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA, and the evolution pipeline itself relies on environments that provide automatic success/failure signals (e.g., task completion flags) to judge whether a rewritten skill is effective. Incorporating domains without such built-in reward signals (e.g., open-ended web tasks or real-world applications Sun et al. (2025)) would require designing external evaluators or human annotations, but would enable the framework to serve an even broader range of agent applications.

zh.html: 伦理考量

en.html: Ethical Considerations

zh.html: 数据与许可。MASA 没有从人类受试者收集新数据；所有实验均使用标准公开基准（ALFWorld、WebShop 和开放域问答数据集），并按照各自许可使用公开发布的模型。

en.html: Data and Licensing. MASA does not introduce new data collection from human subjects; all experiments use standard public benchmarks (ALFWorld, WebShop, and open-domain QA datasets) and publicly released models accessed in accordance with their respective licenses.

zh.html: 增强智能体能力的安全性。通过技能适配提高大语言模型智能体的效能，也可能提升交互环境中智能体的能力。总体而言，在安全关键或高风险场景部署该框架时，应增加监测、策略约束和人工监督。

en.html: Safety of Agent Empowerment. By improving the effectiveness of LLM agents through skill adaptation, MASA may also increase the capability of agents operating in interactive environments. Overall, the framework should be deployed in safety-critical or high-risk settings with additional monitoring, policy constraints, and human oversight.

zh.html: 演化技能的偏见与可靠性。技能演化流程可能继承优化所用轨迹和反馈中的偏见或不安全启发式规则。因此，部署前应检查并验证演化后的技能库。

en.html: Bias and Reliability of Evolved Skills. The skill evolution pipeline may inherit biases or unsafe heuristics from the trajectories and feedback used during optimization. Evolved skill libraries should therefore be inspected and validated before deployment.

en.html: LLM agents and skill libraries.

zh.html: 给大语言模型智能体配备可复用的程序性知识，是一种无需修改模型权重便可扩展地提高智能体表现的方法。ReAct 和 Reflexion 等早期工作将文字反馈作为上下文内技能；Voyager 为 Minecraft 维护不断增长的技能库；JARVIS-1 和 Ghost-in-the-Minecraft 缓存成功行为，供推理时重放；AgentTrek 利用合成轨迹引导网页智能体；AutoManual 从交互轨迹归纳操作手册；ExpeL 将多次试验的经验蒸馏为可复用的见解库。较新的系统进一步将技能提升为智能体的一等组件：SkillRL 将轨迹蒸馏为分层 SkillBank，并随智能体策略递归演化技能；SkillOS 则学习一个长程整理器，在外部 SkillRepo 中插入、更新和删除技能。值得注意的是，SkVM 也识别了模型与技能不匹配的问题：它报告 87% 的任务中至少有一个大语言模型无法从同一技能中获益，并通过将技能编译为优化后的运行时形式（例如代码固化、并行化）来降低延迟和 token 成本。MASA 与之动机相同，但方向互补：我们不为执行效率编译技能，而是改写技能的自然语言表述，使其符合各底座模型的理解与推理风格，直接提高任务成功率。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Yao et al. 模型感知适配与提示词优化。

en.html: Model-aware adaptation and prompt optimization.

zh.html: 即使提示词语义等价，大语言模型的行为也对指令措辞高度敏感，因此需要针对特定底座模型定制提示词。OPRO 和 EvoPrompt 等教师驱动的搜索方法，会针对给定任务迭代优化单条指令，但将目标模型视为固定上下文，输出并不随底座模型变化。MAPO 和 PromptBridge 进一步考虑模型身份，跨底座模型优化或迁移单独的任务指令；但它们处理的是非智能体场景中的单一整体提示词，而不是智能体决策时使用的、可检索的多条目技能库。MASA 有两点不同：（i）优化对象是动态检索的技能库，而非整体提示词；（ii）演化搜索同时受结构化模型能力画像和环境奖励信号引导，明确根据目标模型特征调整技能表述。此外，我们训练轻量级技能改写器，将昂贵的搜索过程摊销到一次前向传播中。这在概念上与把高成本推理时计算蒸馏为高效学习模型有关，使新底座模型无需重复搜索即可适配技能。<small class="source-citations">［原文引用：Sclar et al. (2024)；Yang et al. (2024)；Guo et al. (2024)；Chen et al. (2023)；Wang et al. (2025b)；Singh et al. (2023)］</small>

en.html: LLM behavior is highly sensitive to instruction phrasing even under semantically equivalent prompts Sclar et al. (2024), motivating methods that tailor prompts to specific backbones. Teacher-driven search methods such as OPRO Yang et al. (2024) and EvoPrompt Guo et al. (2024) iteratively refine a single instruction for a given task, yet treat the target model as fixed context—the same output applies regardless of backbone. MAPO Chen et al. (2023) and PromptBridge Wang et al. (2025b) further account for model identity by optimizing or transferring individual task instructions across backbones, yet they operate on single monolithic prompts in non-agent settings rather than on retrievable multi-entry skill libraries used at agent decision time. MASA differs in two key respects: (i) the optimization target is a dynamically retrieved skill library rather than a monolithic prompt, and (ii) the evolutionary search is jointly steered by a structured model capability profile and environment reward signals, explicitly conditioning skill expression on target-model characteristics. Furthermore, we train a lightweight skill rewriter that amortizes the expensive search process into a single forward pass—conceptually related to distilling costly inference-time computation into efficient learned models Singh et al. (2023)—enabling skill adaptation to new backbones without repeated search.

en.html: We ablate the two-stage search structure by replacing each stage’s evolved skills with one-shot teacher (DeepSeek-V4) rewrites, isolating the contribution of each search stage. w/o Task-specific retains MASA-evolved general skills but substitutes teacher-written task-specific skills (i.e., Stage 1 only), while w/o General retains MASA-evolved task-specific skills but uses teacher-written general skills (i.e., Stage 2 only). Both stages contribute to the full pipeline, but their relative importance is environment- and scale-dependent. On ALFWorld, removing task-specific search causes the largest drops for Qwen3-8B (−25.0-25.0) and Qwen3-32B (−15.7-15.7), indicating that per-task-type procedural guidance is critical for these backbones. Conversely, removing general search most severely affects Qwen3-14B (−16.4-16.4), suggesting that high-level behavioral priors are essential when the model has sufficient capacity to follow them but still benefits from strategic framing. On WebShop, removing general skills is catastrophic for 8B/14B/32B (SR drops to single digits), while removing task-specific skills has a comparatively modest effect. This asymmetry reflects the nature of each environment—WebShop demands consistent high-level decision strategies that general skills encode, whereas ALFWorld requires fine-grained procedural sequences that task-specific skills address.

en.html: To verify that the scale-dependent granularity pattern is not unique to Qwen3, we repeat the fixed-granularity sweep on Gemma3 backbones (4B/12B/27B) Kamath et al. (2025). It supports the motivating conclusion: the best skill form is model-dependent rather than universally transferable. Gemma3-4B and Gemma3-12B are strongest with Concise skills, while Gemma3-27B reaches its best success rate with Detailed skills. Figure 4 shows the overall results and Table 6 gives the per-task breakdown.

zh.html: 比较不同家族中参数量相同的模型，可以进一步区分架构和训练的影响与单纯规模的影响。Gemma3-4B 在精简技能下表现最佳，而 Qwen3-4B 在中等技能下达到峰值（对比图 1 与图 4）。尽管参数预算相同，两者对技能粒度的反应却有质的差异。这证实最佳技能形式由模型的整体特性（架构、训练数据、对齐流程）决定，而不能仅以参数量代替模型画像。这一观察进一步表明，技能适配必须以丰富的模型画像为条件。

en.html: Comparing models of the same parameter count across families further isolates the effect of architecture and training from that of scale alone. Gemma3-4B achieves its best performance with Concise skills, whereas Qwen3-4B peaks under Moderate skills (Figure 1 vs. Figure 4). Despite identical parameter budgets, the two models respond to skill granularity in qualitatively different ways—confirming that the optimal skill form is determined by a model’s overall characteristics (architecture, training data, alignment procedure) rather than parameter count alone. This observation reinforces the necessity of conditioning skill adaptation on a rich model profile rather than relying on scale as a proxy.

en.html: Each model card is constructed from a fixed rubric combining public documentation and automated analysis:

zh.html: 架构元数据。模型家族、版本名称、参数量、架构类型、层数／注意力配置、上下文窗口与词表大小，直接取自公开的模型卡或配置文件。

en.html: Architecture metadata. Model family, variant name, parameter count, architecture type, layer/attention configuration, context window, and vocabulary size—sourced directly from the published model card or config files.

zh.html: 训练来源。检查点是基础版还是指令微调版、对齐流程（如 SFT＋DPO＋GRPO）、训练数据规模和多语言支持，取自官方文档。

en.html: Training provenance. Whether the checkpoint is base or instruction-tuned, the alignment pipeline (e.g., SFT + DPO + GRPO), training data scale, and multilingual support—sourced from official documentation.

zh.html: 能力画像。优势从模型官方发布说明中提取（如“擅长数学和代码生成”）；弱点由教师大语言模型根据少量预备运行（第 2 节）中观察到的行为模式总结，自动产生，无需人工标注。

en.html: Capability profile. Strengths are extracted from the model’s official release notes (e.g., “strong at math and code generation”). Weaknesses are generated by the teacher LLM summarizing behavioral patterns observed during a small set of preliminary rollouts (Section 2), produced automatically without human annotation.

zh.html: 请注意，模型卡不包含任何下游评估结果（如 ALFWorld 成功率），也不包含预知答案的风格标签（如 prefers_concise）。用于总结弱点的预备运行与评估集互不重叠。

en.html: Note that the card does not include any downstream evaluation results (e.g., ALFWorld success rates) or oracle style labels (e.g., prefers_concise). The preliminary rollouts used for weakness summarization are disjoint from the evaluation set.

2: R* ← Eval(F, S^G*_F, D)  {全部任务类型上的平均奖励}

14:   S^G*_F ← S^Gi_F；R* ← R_i  {接受}
15: 结束条件判断
16: 如果连续 p 次迭代没有改进：
17:   跳出循环
18: 结束条件判断
19: 结束循环
20: 返回 S^G*_F

zh.html: 只用 Search 和 WebShop 轨迹训练的跨环境改写器（浅蓝色），在所有底座模型的 Heat 任务上表现突出，尤其在 14B（56.2%）和 32B（56.2%）上明显超过 DS-Adapter。对 Clean 和 Cool，跨环境版本的表现更参差：在 4B 和 8B 上达到或略高于 DS-Adapter，但在部分较大底座模型的条件下落后（例如 14B 的 Clean 为 40.7，对 DS-Adapter 的 40.7，二者持平）。这表明，当目标任务涉及与训练环境重叠的决策模式（如 Heat 中的顺序验证）时，跨环境迁移最有效。

en.html: Trained only on Search and WebShop traces, the Cross-env rewriter (light blue) shows notable strengths on Heat across all backbones—particularly 14B (56.2%) and 32B (56.2%)—substantially exceeding DS-Adapter. On Clean and Cool, Cross-env performance is more mixed: it matches or slightly exceeds DS-Adapter for 4B and 8B, but falls short on some larger-backbone cells (e.g., 14B Clean: 40.7 vs. DS-Adapter 40.7, tied). This suggests that cross-environment transfer is most effective when the target task involves decision patterns (e.g., sequential verification in Heat) that overlap with those in the training environments.

en.html: Table 9 presents a case study of how MASA adapts skills differently for each backbone on the same subtask—WebShop’s color-matching decision, identified as the highest-failure-rate subtask during skill evolution.

zh.html: 演化流程并非只产生措辞上的细微变化，而是针对各模型的主要失败模式发现了性质不同的策略：

en.html: Rather than producing minor wording variations, the evolution pipeline discovers qualitatively distinct strategies tailored to each model’s dominant failure mode:

zh.html: Qwen3-4B 倾向于猜测视觉上相似的颜色。演化技能施加严格的二元规则：完全匹配，否则立即离开。

en.html: Qwen3-4B tends to guess visually similar colors. The evolved skill imposes a strict binary rule: match exactly or leave immediately.

zh.html: Qwen3-8B 太容易放弃商品，因而得零分。演化技能鼓励购买近似匹配的商品，以获得部分分数。

en.html: Qwen3-8B abandons products too easily, scoring zero. The evolved skill encourages buying approximate matches for partial credit.

zh.html: Qwen3-14B 在不合适的商品上耗费步骤反复斟酌。演化技能规定：没有完全匹配时，用一步迅速退出。

en.html: Qwen3-14B wastes steps deliberating on bad products. The evolved skill enforces a one-step fast-fail exit when no exact match exists.

zh.html: Qwen3-32B 不善于处理编码后的颜色名（如 d01green）。演化技能提供带有平局决胜规则的算法式子串匹配流程。

en.html: Qwen3-32B mishandles coded color names (e.g., d01green). The evolved skill provides an algorithmic substring-matching procedure with tie-breaking rules.

zh.html: 这表明，模型条件适配作用于决策策略层面：面对同一个问题，不同底座模型因失败方式不同，需要根本不同的解决办法。

en.html: This demonstrates that model-conditioned adaptation operates at the level of decision strategy—the same problem requires fundamentally different solutions depending on how each backbone fails.
